scope: Bounded independent audit of Phanes static foliage shadow-cache geometry, admission limits, invalidation and CGE fallback behavior. This report does not review or pass the registered terrain-landforms feature, its WFC/editing requirements, or physical-phone performance.

intuitiveness.evidence: Unsupported modes and exhausted admission fall back to the ordinary CGE renderer, while geometry, light, transform and context changes invalidate cached buffers. The current desktop and phone-layout captures keep the world legible and retain the expected creation controls through recovery.

accuracy.evidence: The independent geometry probe passes 138394 checks with zero failures across 1120 shape cases, including synthetic reversed-edge cancellation, pinned welded adjacency, exact cap ordering, transforms, directional lights and point-light rejection. The current seed-732 size-12 candidate render is hash-bound to WASM 3994c8a515573e3329bd862b71f3a132687b6c2e815885e2ed192004e12cf8bc; desktop, phone-layout and recovered baseline/candidate images each have zero differing pixels, and recovery preserves the world exactly.

wowFactor.evidence: The current 192-metre populated scene visibly shows coherent tree, crop and structure shadows in desktop Orbit, phone-layout first person and recovered captures. The paired captures are byte-identical, so the cache preserves the rendered result while supporting the candidate's measured frame-rate improvement.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: The cache reuses GPU silhouette and cap geometry while retaining CGE per-frame caster visibility, stencil configuration and cap selection. Conservative admission, independent temporary limits, staged all-entry commits and ordinary-engine fallback make the optimization useful without changing scene ownership or collision behavior.
